sessionPolicy: Persist until explicit logout or a validated permanent session failure.
dataPolicy: No fabricated production analytics or user counts.

claims.physicalDeviceValidation: Required after deploy; not inferred from static source checks.
claims.providerLoginValidation: Requires configured Google, LinkedIn OIDC, and email providers in the deployed Supabase project.
claims.capacity: No 900-million-user or other mass-capacity claim without provider and load-test evidence.
